description: Per-category generation profiles for the AMP Challenge 2027. One generalized AutoGuard safety/toxicity module conditions on `safety_category_index` to target each category; the same module + ranking key produces all five libraries. This file only declares the targets — it does NOT trigger generation.

categories.name: broad_spectrum
categories.ranking_metric: overall_success_rate; ties broken by MIC90 across all strains

categories.name: gram_pos
categories.ranking_metric: gram_positive_success_rate; ties broken by MIC50 across Gram-positive strains

categories.name: gram_neg
categories.ranking_metric: gram_negative_success_rate; ties broken by MIC50 across Gram-negative strains

categories.name: mdr
categories.ranking_metric: MDR_success_rate; ties broken by MIC50 across MDR ESKAPE strains

categories.name: therapeutic
categories.description: Optimal selectivity: best safety window, potency-gated and non-hemolytic.
categories.ranking_metric: safety_window (SW); peptides must meet MIC <= 16 uM in >= 1 strain; non-hemolytic ties broken by lowest MIC50
